question: What does error E-2417 mean on the Pika generation 3, and which part fixes it?
expected_answer: Gripper vacuum is low: below 55 kPa for more than 2 seconds. Replace or reset the suction cup kit, part AUR-PK3-4471-B.

gold.span: E-2417 GRIPPER_VACUUM_LOW. Raised when vacuum below 55 kPa for more than 2 seconds. Usual cause: wear or damage to the suction cup kit. Fix: replace or reset the suction cup kit (AUR-PK3-4471-B)

notes: Org-wide manual at clearance 1. The gen 2 manual (field-ops only) has the same code with a different fix; this user can't see it.

question: How many days of paid vacation do I get each year?
expected_answer: 22 days a year (2026 handbook, version 2026.1), on top of public holidays.

gold.span: Every full-time employee receives 22 days of paid vacation each calendar year, on top of public holidays.

distractors.span: Every full-time employee receives 20 days of paid vacation each calendar year, on top of public holidays.

notes: Both handbooks are visible to everyone in Aurora. Answering 20 means the older version won.
